# Your Trusted Source for Security, AV and Smart Living Solutions

ADI is a leading distributor and solution provider of security, AV, and smart living products
serving over 100,000 customers worldwide. We offer access to a broad portfolio of products,
including top-tier distributed brands and our own exclusive brands.

With more than three decades of industry experience, we're committed to building long-lasting
customer relationships - making us a preferred partner for professionals across the industry.

# Our Mission

### We aim to provide products, services and software that help keep our communities safe, secure,
### comfortable and connected.

## Here's How We Do It

### Access to Exclusive Brands

We take pride in our exclusive, in-house manufactured products and software solutions, delivering
smart solutions that combine quality and innovation. From home automation to commercial-grade
infrastructure, we craft technologies that focus on what customers value most – delivering a
reliable and exceptional experience

[Access to Exclusive Brands]
[Support and Services]

### Support and Services

We offer a wide range of support and services to provide expert guidance at every step - from design
and configuration to ongoing support. With OvrC Remote Management, customers can easily manage,
configure, and troubleshoot devices across the network. OvrC is available on a range of exclusive
brand products and integrates with many leading distributed brands. Additional offerings include
systems design, technical support, rewards programs, training, project registration, and more.

### Robust Product Selection

With more than 500,000 products from over 1,000 trusted brands, ADI offers a carefully curated
selection of solutions to meet the needs for any application. We make purchasing easy - customers
can shop in-store or online and choose from multiple delivery options or in-store pickup.

For screen sharing, video conferencing, digital signage, emergency alerts, and remote management.

## Turn every screen into a collaboration tool

Most organizations use separate tools for screen sharing, video calls, digital signage, and
emergency alerts — and the fragmentation slows everyone down. Airtame brings it all together in one
platform. Easy to roll out, simple to manage, and intuitive for anyone to use.

10,000+ organizations and counting

Connecting rooms, people, and ideas.

From people who use it every day — and count on it.

Get started with the Airtame essentials for less. Screen sharing, signage, alerts, and remote
management — bundled with hardware, an Ethernet adapter, a 3-year license, and a 3-year warranty.

Airtame 3 combines faster performance and easier deployment in one device. It’s built for scale, so
IT can roll out, manage, and update screens remotely, while users enjoy a consistent, reliable
experience across rooms.

[ Explore Airtame 3 ][39]

Virtual Airtame gives you the full Airtame experience — screen sharing, conferencing, signage, and
alerts — without Airtame hardware. Extend the life of your current setup, mix it with Airtame 3
where needed, and give every screen the same intuitive experience.

# Airtame is the platform that makes screens easy to use

For screen sharing, video conferencing, digital signage, emergency alerts, and remote management.

[ Talk to us ][34]

## Turn every screen into a collaboration tool

Most organizations use separate tools for screen sharing, video calls, digital signage, and
emergency alerts — and the fragmentation slows everyone down. Airtame brings it all together in one
platform. Easy to roll out, simple to manage, and intuitive for anyone to use.

10,000+ organizations and counting

Connecting rooms, people, and ideas.

Rated 4.6/5

From people who use it every day — and count on it.

## Airtame Go: The most affordable way to make your screens useful

Get started with the Airtame essentials for less. Screen sharing, signage, alerts, and remote
management — bundled with hardware, an Ethernet adapter, a 3-year license, and a 3-year warranty.

[ Education ][37]
[ Business ][38]
[Airtame Go][Airtame Go]

## Meet Airtame 3, our most powerful device

Airtame 3 combines faster performance and easier deployment in one device. It’s built for scale, so
IT can roll out, manage, and update screens remotely, while users enjoy a consistent, reliable
experience across rooms.

[ Explore Airtame 3 ][39]

## Bring the Airtame experience to your own hardware

Virtual Airtame gives you the full Airtame experience — screen sharing, conferencing, signage, and
alerts — without Airtame hardware. Extend the life of your current setup, mix it with Airtame 3
where needed, and give every screen the same intuitive experience.

#### About us

We are a professional broadcast (SI) System Integrator in Malaysia that are currently serving the
private and government sector based on the TV & Radio industry.

Our mission is to provide solutions and products that will enhance and simplify your workflows with
the most holistic approach. Combined with our vast experience garnered from the broadcast industry,
we are able to design and execute various strategic workflows to automate and enhance your broadcast
operations successfully.

We also represent many renown broadcasting equipment manufacturers and solution providers over the
years. From Multiple Camera Productions (MCP) to Studio Lighting and Luminaires setup, from a single
4K, HD or SD Channel In A Box Video Playout Automation to Multiple Channel Playout, Channel Branding
or Character Generator (CG) and Graphics Playout or even SCTE 104 / SCTE 35 automatic Ads Insertion.
We also specialize in powerful and essential systems for broadcasters such as Media Asset Management
(MAM), Traffic System or Broadcast Management System (BMS), Newsroom Computer System (NRCS),
Electronic News Gathering (ENG), Over The Top TV (OTT), Compliance Recording system, Video on Demand
(VOD), 3D Virtual Sets, Subtitling Solutions, Video File Transcoding, Video File QC & Monitoring
systems, Video Streaming solutions, File Transfer Acceleration and Transport Stream Analyzer. Also
not forgetting Broadcast GLUES such as PTZ Cameras, Encoders, Converters, Production Switchers,
Video Routers, Video I/O boards and many more. We also carry a Work OS system to keep track all of
your employees productivity in real-time.

We can devise a complete end-to-end broadcast solution for you which includes Disaster Recovery
setups, Cloud Computing, File Based Workflows, Storage and IT Data Center setup as well. Whether it
is SDI or IP workflows that you need, you can be sure to find something in need from our vast
inventory and with our specialized team, we can help you to integrate the products or solutions that
you have chosen from us either on your exiting or new infrastructure.

We are ready to assist and empower your organization to achieve the best results with the return of
investment that you have come to expect.

corporate, education, worship, and creator environments.

Build flexible live production workflows with professional cameras, IP video tools, converters, and
control solutions designed for real-world production.

[Link][182]
[corp-icon]

## Corporate & Hybrid Meetings

Make meetings, town halls, and hybrid events look more professional with simple, reliable video
tools for modern workplace communication.

[Link][183]

## Education

Capture lectures, connect classrooms, support simulation labs, and scale video across campus with
flexible tools for teaching and learning.

[Link][184]
[worship-icon]

## House of Worship

Stream services, connect overflow rooms, and support volunteer-friendly production workflows with
cameras and video tools built for worship teams.

## Content Creation & Podcasting

Create polished video content, podcasts, live streams, and studio productions with professional
tools that are easy to set up and scale.

Organizations around the world rely on BirdDog to simplify their video production environments.

“We’ve been working with BirdDog since almost the beginning, around eight years now. They’re a

“To stream a game, I just tap twice — go live, done. It’s that easy.”

“One cable for power, control, and video. It changed everything.”

“I had one handheld operator and one PTZ operator. That’s all we needed. The rest ran seamlessly
through NDI. No issues, no dropouts, just plug-and-play.”

##### Tony Liuzzi

##### Editor, Producer, Multi Camera Director

“What I like about BirdDog products — especially the X-Series — is that they cater to specific
needs. If you’re a musician, there’s a model that suits you better than the others. If you’re a

“Compared to our previous setup using fixed DSLRs with limited control, this was a night and day

Broadcast Solutions plant und realisiert Projekte für die Broadcast- und Medienbranche.

Wir bieten innovative und zukunftsfähige Lösungen für die Broadcast- und Medienbranche. Unsere
Ü-Wagen, Studio- und Sendeeinrichtungen, Einheiten zur Satellitenkommunikation und Produkte zur
Steuerung komplexer Broadcast-Workflows sind weltweit im Einsatz.

[Mobil][33]

Übertragungswagen nach Ihren Wünschen oder aus unserer vorkonfigurierten Streamline-Serie

[Studio][34]

Wir realisieren komplexe Studios, Playout Center, Regien oder MCR

[Veranstaltungs­stätten][35]

Flexible AV-Medien und Broadcasttechnik für die Veranstaltungsstätten der Zukunft

[Satcom][36]

Ganz gleich ob SNG oder VSAT, mobil oder festinstalliert – die Verbindung steht

## Unsere Leistungen

Wir planen und realisieren Projekte und Lösungen, welche die komplette Wertschöpfung der Broadcast-
und Medienbranche abbilden.
Full-Service Produktionssupport ist bei vielen unserer Projekte eine Selbstverständlichkeit.  

### [Systemintegration][37]

Seit 2003 bietet Broadcast Solutions seinen Kunden maßgeschneiderte Lösungen. Wir sind in der Lage
nahezu jedes Projekt im Bereich Broadcast zu planen und zu realisieren - weltweit.
Wir sind Spezialisten in der Systemintegration, ganz gleich, ob es um mobile Produktionsmittel
(Ü-Wagen, Satcom) oder Festinstallationen (Studios, Playout Center, MCR) geht.

### [Produkte & Service][38]

Die Broadcast Solutions Produkte und Service GmbH ist der kompetente Partner mit Anspruch,
Leidenschaft und Service für Medienschaffende aus allen Bereichen.
Wir bieten kompetente Beratung, Verkauf und Service von Software und Equipment für Medienschaffende
aus Broadcast, Film-, Fernseh- und Videoproduktionen, Sendeanstalten, Industrie- und
Werbefilmproduktionen.

### [Beratung & Support][39]

Wir sehen das große Ganze. Grundlegender Bestandteil unserer Philosophie ist die Beratung und der
Service vor und während eines Projektes.
Ganz gleich an welchem Projekt wir arbeiten, innovatives Projektmanagement und Serviceleistungen
sind Teil unserer Dienstleistung, um unsere Kunden zu beraten und die Projekte zum Erfolg zu führen.

## Produkt-Innovationen von Broadcast Solutions

### [meshLINK][45]

**THE NEW WIRELESS.**

Mit meshLINK macht Broadcast Solutions die nächste Generation der drahtlosen Übertragung
hochwertiger Videosignale verfügbar. Modernste Videocodierung, Vollduplex-IP und Mesh-Vernetzung in
einem robusten und unkomplizierten System.

### [Streamline Ü-Wagen][46]

**Der Übertragungswagen-Standard, der alle Bedürfnisse erfüllt. **

Die Streamline Übertragungswagen repräsentieren die Quintessenz von mehr als 20 Jahren Erfahrung im
Bau von mobilen Produktionseinheiten. Mit mehr als 40 gebauten Fahrzeugen sind sie die
erfolgreichsten Ü-Wagen der Welt!

### Wer ist Broadcast Solutions

Entdecken Sie die Welt der Broadcast Solutions GmbH, Ihren Spezialisten für die Integration von
Rundfunk- und Medientechnologie, der seit 2003 deutsche Ingenieurkunst mit globaler Reichweite
verbindet. Unser internationales Team aus über 500 Fachleuten vereint umfassende Erfahrungen und
eine multikulturelle Perspektive, die wir bereits in über 700 Projekten weltweit umgesetzt haben.
Mit Niederlassungen in 14 Ländern bieten wir nicht nur lokale Einblicke, sondern auch weltweite
Fachkenntnisse, die jede unserer Installationen und Dienstleistungen – von Live-Produktion bis zu
Streaming- und Broadcast-Infrastruktur – prägen.

Unsere Experten sind mehr als nur versierte Techniker; sie sind Pioniere und Meinungsführer in der
Broadcast-Industrie, die sich der Entwicklung innovativer Lösungen für die Übertragungstechnik
verschrieben haben. Ob für Fernsehstudios, Übertragungswagen, Satellitenkommunikation oder
Softwareentwicklung für Medienmanagement – vertrauen Sie auf unser Team, das mit unvergleichlicher
Fachkenntnis und dem Geist der Innovation Ihr Projekt zum Erfolg führt. Broadcast Solutions steht
für fortschrittliche Technologielösungen, die die Grenzen des Möglichen in der Welt des Rundfunks
neu definieren.

Wir laden Sie ein, sich mit uns in Verbindung zu setzen und zu erfahren, wie unsere Expertise Ihr
nächstes Projekt voranbringen kann. Entdecken Sie, warum Broadcast Solutions das Synonym für
Innovation und Exzellenz in der Broadcast-Technologiebranche ist.

### Broadcast Solutions Leistungsangebot

Begeben Sie sich auf eine umfassende Reise mit Broadcast Solutions, Ihrem allumfassenden Partner in
der Broadcast Technologie. Unser Dienstleistungsangebot ist sorgfältig darauf ausgelegt, jeden
Aspekt der Rundfunk- und Medienbranche abzudecken.

Vom ersten Funken einer Idee bis zur Übertragung eines Rundfunksignals bieten wir ein komplettes
Spektrum an Lösungen, einschließlich Systemintegration, Projektplanung und schlüsselfertiger
Implementierung. Unser Angebot erstreckt sich auf maßgeschneiderte Ü-Wagen, modernste
Studioeinrichtungen und fortschrittliche Satellitenkommunikationssysteme, alles unterstützt durch
unseren herstellerunabhängigen Ansatz, der die besten Produkte und Marken der Branche einbezieht.
Mit einem Engagement für Innovation bieten wir auch ausgefeilte Produkte zur Steuerung komplexer
Rundfunk-Workflows, drahtlosen Signaltransport oder schlüsselfertige Außenübertragungsfahrzeuge an.
Unsere Dienstleistungsethik basiert auf einem ganzheitlichen Ansatz, der Beratung, fortlaufende
Projektunterstützung und eine vollständige Produktionsrückendeckung bietet. Ob zur Miete oder zum
Kauf, unsere Ausrüstung und Lösungen sind darauf ausgerichtet, Ihr Business zu verbessern. Wählen
Sie Broadcast Solutions für ein Dienstleistungserlebnis, das traditionelle Grenzen überwindet und
den Erfolg Ihres Projekts mit unserer unvergleichlichen Expertise in der Broadcast Technologie
sicherstellt.

### Mobile Installationen

Broadcast Solutions zeichnet sich durch die Entwicklung mobiler Produktionstools aus, die Ihre
Rundfunkvisionen zum Leben erwecken, wohin sie auch führen mögen. Unsere Expertise liegt im Bau von
maßgeschneiderten Übertragungswagen für Außeneinsätze, die sorgfältig entworfen sind, um den
einzigartigen Anforderungen Ihrer Live-Produktionen gerecht zu werden, unabhängig von deren Umfang.
Von kompakten Einheiten bis hin zu großen Ü-Wagen mit 24 oder mehr Kameras sind unsere individuellen
Lösungen mit Blick auf Ihre spezifischen betrieblichen Bedürfnisse und technologischen Vorlieben
konzipiert. Unsere Ü-Wagen beinhalten die neuesten technischen Möglichkeiten: HDR, UHD, Full-IP,
SMPTE ST 2110.

Neben maßgeschneiderten Produktionstools bieten wir die Streamline-Familie von Ü-Wagen an – unsere
charakteristische Reihe von vorkonfigurierten Übertragungswagen für Außeneinsätze. Diese Einheiten
sind der Inbegriff unserer Erfahrung und Effizienz, einsatzbereit und perfekt für Rundfunkanstalten,
die schnelle, zuverlässige und kosteneffektive Lösungen benötigen, ohne auf die Anfertigung nach Maß
warten zu müssen.

Jede mobile Installation, ob individuell angefertigt oder aus unserer Streamline-Serie, ist ein
Beleg für unser Engagement für Qualität, Innovation und die Anpassungsfähigkeit unserer Lösungen im
dynamischen Bereich der Live-Rundfunkproduktion.

### Festinstallationen

Broadcast Solutions ist führend bei der Planung und Installation fester Broadcast Einrichtungen und
schafft zukunftsorientierte Rundfunkumgebungen, die modernste Technologien nutzen. Unsere Expertise
erstreckt sich auf das Design und die Implementierung von IP-basierten Produktionsstätten, die eine
unvergleichliche Flexibilität und Skalierbarkeit für moderne Rundfunkanforderungen bieten. Wir sind
versiert im Aufbau von Remote-Produktionszentren, die eine nahtlose Zusammenarbeit und Produktion
von verschiedenen Standorten aus ermöglichen und sicherstellen, dass Ihre Produktion nicht durch
geografische Einschränkungen begrenzt ist.

Unser Ansatz für hybride Produktionsstätten integriert traditionelle Rundfunkmethoden mit den
neuesten digitalen Technologien und ermöglicht einen reibungslosen Übergang in die Zukunft der
Medienproduktion. Wir sind auch spezialisiert auf die Planung und Implementierung von virtuellen
Studios, die Augmented Reality (AR) und Virtual Reality (VR) nutzen, um immersive und fesselnde
Seherlebnisse zu schaffen.

Über das visuelle Spektakel hinaus umfassen unsere Fähigkeiten die Entwicklung von Studio-Komplexen,
Master Control Rooms (MCRs) und fortschrittlichen News-Systemen, die den Produktionsprozess
optimieren. Wir implementieren ausgeklügelte Media Asset Management (MAM)-Systeme und Datenhubs, die
ein effizientes Management, Speicherung und Abrufen von Medieninhalten gewährleisten und das
Rückgrat Ihrer Rundfunkinfrastruktur bilden.

Broadcast Solutions zeichnet sich durch die Entwicklung mobiler Produktionstools aus, die Ihre
Rundfunkvisionen zum Leben erwecken, wohin sie auch führen mögen. Unsere Expertise liegt im Bau von
maßgeschneiderten Übertragungswagen für Außeneinsätze, die sorgfältig entworfen sind, um den
einzigartigen Anforderungen Ihrer Live-Produktionen gerecht zu werden, unabhängig von deren Umfang.
Von kompakten Einheiten bis hin zu großen Ü-Wagen mit 24 oder mehr Kameras sind unsere individuellen
Lösungen mit Blick auf Ihre spezifischen betrieblichen Bedürfnisse und technologischen Vorlieben
konzipiert. Unsere Ü-Wagen beinhalten die neuesten technischen Möglichkeiten: HDR, UHD, Full-IP,
SMPTE ST 2110.

Neben maßgeschneiderten Produktionstools bieten wir die Streamline-Familie von Ü-Wagen an – unsere
charakteristische Reihe von vorkonfigurierten Übertragungswagen für Außeneinsätze. Diese Einheiten
sind der Inbegriff unserer Erfahrung und Effizienz, einsatzbereit und perfekt für Rundfunkanstalten,
die schnelle, zuverlässige und kosteneffektive Lösungen benötigen, ohne auf die Anfertigung nach Maß
warten zu müssen.

Jede mobile Installation, ob individuell angefertigt oder aus unserer Streamline-Serie, ist ein
Beleg für unser Engagement für Qualität, Innovation und die Anpassungsfähigkeit unserer Lösungen im
dynamischen Bereich der Live-Rundfunkproduktion.

### Festinstallationen

Broadcast Solutions ist führend bei der Planung und Installation fester Broadcast Einrichtungen und
schafft zukunftsorientierte Rundfunkumgebungen, die modernste Technologien nutzen. Unsere Expertise
erstreckt sich auf das Design und die Implementierung von IP-basierten Produktionsstätten, die eine
unvergleichliche Flexibilität und Skalierbarkeit für moderne Rundfunkanforderungen bieten. Wir sind
versiert im Aufbau von Remote-Produktionszentren, die eine nahtlose Zusammenarbeit und Produktion
von verschiedenen Standorten aus ermöglichen und sicherstellen, dass Ihre Produktion nicht durch
geografische Einschränkungen begrenzt ist.

Unser Ansatz für hybride Produktionsstätten integriert traditionelle Rundfunkmethoden mit den
neuesten digitalen Technologien und ermöglicht einen reibungslosen Übergang in die Zukunft der
Medienproduktion. Wir sind auch spezialisiert auf die Planung und Implementierung von virtuellen
Studios, die Augmented Reality (AR) und Virtual Reality (VR) nutzen, um immersive und fesselnde
Seherlebnisse zu schaffen.

Über das visuelle Spektakel hinaus umfassen unsere Fähigkeiten die Entwicklung von Studio-Komplexen,
Master Control Rooms (MCRs) und fortschrittlichen News-Systemen, die den Produktionsprozess
optimieren. Wir implementieren ausgeklügelte Media Asset Management (MAM)-Systeme und Datenhubs, die
ein effizientes Management, Speicherung und Abrufen von Medieninhalten gewährleisten und das
Rückgrat Ihrer Rundfunkinfrastruktur bilden.

# Integrated Playout, Live Captioning, Subtitling, Compliance Monitoring and Time Delay

[Linear Playout][59][Captioning Services][60][Time
Delay][61][Transcription Services][62]
[[Previous]Previous][63][[Next]Next][64]

# Linear Playout
* Simplify operations in one unique software
* Combine and integrate file-preparation, captioning and subtitling, graphics, scheduling, playout,
  recording, and switching.
* Streamline workflow and deliver high-quality efficient playout that improves operations and on-air
  presentation

[OASYS Integrated Playout][65]

# Captioning Software and Services

Looking to add captions to your videos or broadcasts? BroadStream provides a variety of advanced ASR
software solutions that allow broadcasters and video producers to easily add accurate captions to
their videos. 

Interested in automatically uploading captions to your videos? Learn more about our closed
captioning services and how you can easily create captions and transcript files for your videos by
simply uploading them online.
* Easily add captions and subtitles to any video or TV program
* Benefit from ASR products that provide live captioning, encoding, reversioning, and product
  monitoring
* Innovative and accurate live captioning software that creates live captions on the fly for a
  variety of programs such as breaking news

[Live, Real-Time Captions][66] [Captioning Software][67] [Caption Manipulation][68] [Caption
Insertion][69] [Subtitling and Transcription Services][70]

# Time Delay

BroadStream offers several options for broadcasters who need to delay program playout:
* Record a fixed time delay from a single live input for playout to a single program output. This is
  a separate application, called ARMADA, and is designed for unattended operation.
* Record a live input(s) for a rolling 24-hour period with the ability to adjust your time delay
  events for a variable time delay.
* Record and replay with user specified time delays or replay on demand. This is used with OASYS
  PLAYER only and is not intended to be run as a standalone application.

[Time Delay Solutions][71]

# Transcription & Translation Services

Convert your audio to text with our transcription services that use innovative ASR technology to
provide accurate speech to text transcripts! Need translation? Also available at
https://subcaptioner.com 
* Transcribe speech to text using ASR technology
* Starting at $0.25 / Minute of audio
* Accurate text files and fast turnaround times thanks to our ASR technology that picks up the human
  voice with ease. 

[Transcription Services][72]

# THE TEAM BROADCASTERS TRUST WORLDWIDE

With 5 global offices and 4 satellite offices around the world, our team is available for support
and sales in every region and every time zone.

# Read more about what our customers are saying

**KTSF-TV**

I recognized system ROI from the very beginning as it took, literally, just a few minutes to
transfer the existing automation Metadata database to the OASYS system. There would be no
re-prepping of our existing files.  The dual 10gig ports on the servers enabled us to transfer 17TB
of files extremely fast.  Once the legacy video server files were transferred they played natively
without transcoding, and saved us countless hours…

**Trenton Mengel**Director of Engineering

**KUAC-TV**

This was a very smooth commissioning project. The OASYS system was able to scan our Sundance
database and collect the important metadata and saved us endless hours of time in preparing content
for the new system. In addition, the platform has a smaller footprint, is less costly to operate and
improves our flexibility, which helps operationally as we schedule more unmanned hours in Master
Control…

**Keith Martin**General Manager & Director of Technology

**WVIA-TV**

This was a big change for us and our BroadStream Project Engineer worked with us from beginning to
end to configure the system, work out the kinks and help us get ready for the launch. The OASYS
platform gives us much more capability and flexibility than our previous master control system,
which helps tremendously as we move to more unmanned hours in Master Control…

**Joe Glynn**Vice President of Engineering at WVIA

**NOW-TV**

The OASYS platform was just what we were looking for. Not only does it provide multi-channel playout
of live and pre-recorded content with broadcast quality graphics from a single IT server; the system
can also dynamically manage channel redundancy with 1:1, M:1 and/or M:N configurations with channel
prioritization. For us, this reliability and resilience were absolutely imperative in our purchasing
decision…

**Alan Chan**VP Broadcast Operations & Engineering, PCCW

**KOCT-Oceanside, CA**

Oceanside Community Services Television Corp, KOCT, purchased a BroadStream Solutions, OASYS
Broadcast Television Integrated Playout system in 2017.

Using the simple installation and connection documentation provided, KOCT engineers installed and
connected the equipment. The system was fully functional within hours after BroadStream’s field
engineers arrived to finalize the installation…

**Bill Peters**Chief Engineer, KOCT-Oceanside, CA

LATV-Los Angeles

LATV delivers locally produced content to its owned and operated KJLA, KXLA and KVMD channels, as
well as affiliates across the USA. Currently the network uses two different workflows, at separate
locations within the same facility, that each constitute separate servers, automation and scheduling
systems, along with two separate playout operator teams, each producing different file types.

As these separate, dedicated pieces of broadcast hardware were end-of-life, LATV replaced them with
BroadStream’s OASYS Integrated Playout platform…

**LATV-Los Angeles**

# Integrated Playout, Live Captioning, Subtitling, Compliance Monitoring and Time Delay

[Linear Playout][59][Captioning Services][60][Time
Delay][61][Transcription Services][62]
[[Previous]Previous][63][[Next]Next][64]

# Linear Playout
* Simplify operations in one unique software
* Combine and integrate file-preparation, captioning and subtitling, graphics, scheduling, playout,
  recording, and switching.
* Streamline workflow and deliver high-quality efficient playout that improves operations and on-air
  presentation

[OASYS Integrated Playout][65]

# Captioning Software and Services

Looking to add captions to your videos or broadcasts? BroadStream provides a variety of advanced ASR
software solutions that allow broadcasters and video producers to easily add accurate captions to
their videos. 

Interested in automatically uploading captions to your videos? Learn more about our closed
captioning services and how you can easily create captions and transcript files for your videos by
simply uploading them online.
* Easily add captions and subtitles to any video or TV program
* Benefit from ASR products that provide live captioning, encoding, reversioning, and product
  monitoring
* Innovative and accurate live captioning software that creates live captions on the fly for a
  variety of programs such as breaking news

[Live, Real-Time Captions][66] [Captioning Software][67] [Caption Manipulation][68] [Caption
Insertion][69] [Subtitling and Transcription Services][70]

# Time Delay

BroadStream offers several options for broadcasters who need to delay program playout:
* Record a fixed time delay from a single live input for playout to a single program output. This is
  a separate application, called ARMADA, and is designed for unattended operation.
* Record a live input(s) for a rolling 24-hour period with the ability to adjust your time delay
  events for a variable time delay.
* Record and replay with user specified time delays or replay on demand. This is used with OASYS
  PLAYER only and is not intended to be run as a standalone application.

[Time Delay Solutions][71]

# Transcription & Translation Services

Convert your audio to text with our transcription services that use innovative ASR technology to
provide accurate speech to text transcripts! Need translation? Also available at
https://subcaptioner.com 
* Transcribe speech to text using ASR technology
* Starting at $0.25 / Minute of audio
* Accurate text files and fast turnaround times thanks to our ASR technology that picks up the human
  voice with ease. 

[Transcription Services][72]

# THE TEAM BROADCASTERS TRUST WORLDWIDE

With 5 global offices and 4 satellite offices around the world, our team is available for support
and sales in every region and every time zone.

# Read more about what our customers are saying

**KTSF-TV**

I recognized system ROI from the very beginning as it took, literally, just a few minutes to
transfer the existing automation Metadata database to the OASYS system. There would be no
re-prepping of our existing files.  The dual 10gig ports on the servers enabled us to transfer 17TB
of files extremely fast.  Once the legacy video server files were transferred they played natively
without transcoding, and saved us countless hours…

**Trenton Mengel**Director of Engineering

**KUAC-TV**

This was a very smooth commissioning project. The OASYS system was able to scan our Sundance
database and collect the important metadata and saved us endless hours of time in preparing content
for the new system. In addition, the platform has a smaller footprint, is less costly to operate and
improves our flexibility, which helps operationally as we schedule more unmanned hours in Master
Control…

**Keith Martin**General Manager & Director of Technology

**WVIA-TV**

This was a big change for us and our BroadStream Project Engineer worked with us from beginning to
end to configure the system, work out the kinks and help us get ready for the launch. The OASYS
platform gives us much more capability and flexibility than our previous master control system,
which helps tremendously as we move to more unmanned hours in Master Control…

**Joe Glynn**Vice President of Engineering at WVIA

**NOW-TV**

The OASYS platform was just what we were looking for. Not only does it provide multi-channel playout
of live and pre-recorded content with broadcast quality graphics from a single IT server; the system
can also dynamically manage channel redundancy with 1:1, M:1 and/or M:N configurations with channel
prioritization. For us, this reliability and resilience were absolutely imperative in our purchasing
decision…

**Alan Chan**VP Broadcast Operations & Engineering, PCCW

**KOCT-Oceanside, CA**

Oceanside Community Services Television Corp, KOCT, purchased a BroadStream Solutions, OASYS
Broadcast Television Integrated Playout system in 2017.

Using the simple installation and connection documentation provided, KOCT engineers installed and
connected the equipment. The system was fully functional within hours after BroadStream’s field
engineers arrived to finalize the installation…

**Bill Peters**Chief Engineer, KOCT-Oceanside, CA

LATV-Los Angeles

LATV delivers locally produced content to its owned and operated KJLA, KXLA and KVMD channels, as
well as affiliates across the USA. Currently the network uses two different workflows, at separate
locations within the same facility, that each constitute separate servers, automation and scheduling
systems, along with two separate playout operator teams, each producing different file types.

As these separate, dedicated pieces of broadcast hardware were end-of-life, LATV replaced them with
BroadStream’s OASYS Integrated Playout platform…

**LATV-Los Angeles**

Our distribution network covers the UAE, Qatar, Saudi Arabia, Jordan, Egypt, Morocco, Algeria, and
Tunisia, ensuring fast access to trusted solutions across the region.

We are committed to helping partners grow by combining premium products with industry expertise and
dedicated service.

#### Mission

We empower partners with a 360° product portfolio, regional distribution in UAE, Qatar, KSA, Jordan,
Egypt, Morocco, Algeria, and Tunisia, and expert support to deliver successful projects.

#### Vision

To be the leading broadcast and Pro AV distributor in MEA, connecting resellers and integrators with
world-class brands and reliable solutions.

#### Broadcast & AV Distribution Across MEA

We supply a 360° portfolio of broadcast, audio, and AV equipment from trusted international brands,
with efficient logistics that ensure reliable access in every market.

#### Professional Technical Support

From pre-sales consulting to solution design and demonstrations, our specialists provide the
guidance needed to select and integrate the right products seamlessly.

#### Reseller Enablement Programs

We empower partners with training, marketing resources, and sales support to help them grow their
business and strengthen client relationships.

#### Certified After-Sales Service

As an authorized Canon service center, we offer maintenance and certified repairs for cameras and
lenses, ensuring long-term reliability and trusted care.

#### Regional Coverage & Local Access

With active distribution in the UAE, Qatar, Saudi Arabia, Jordan, Egypt, Morocco, Algeria, and
Tunisia, we provide partners with local market access and fast delivery.

#### Authorized Canon Service Center

BSS is an Authorized Canon Service Center for professional cameras and lenses, delivering certified
repair, maintenance, and calibration services using genuine Canon parts and manufacturer-approved
standards.

## Frequently Asked Questions

What is IPTV middleware?

IPTV middleware is software that acts as a bridge between the IPTV service provider and the end-user
device, allowing the provider to deliver and manage their IPTV service on the user’s device.

What features does IPTV middleware typically include?

IPTV middleware typically includes features like content management, user authentication, billing
integration, and analytics for tracking viewership. It provides an intuitive user interface,
supports multiple devices (e.g., TVs, mobile phones, tablets), and enables content personalization
through recommendations and user preferences.

How does IPTV middleware work?

IPTV middleware serves as a central system that connects the IPTV backend (servers and content
sources) to user devices, coordinating content delivery and user interactions. It manages content
distribution by encoding and streaming video data, authenticates users, and handles subscriptions
and billing.

What types of devices can IPTV middleware be used on?


IPTV middleware can be used on a variety of devices, including Smart TVs, set-top boxes, desktop
computers, tablets, and smartphones. It also supports streaming on gaming consoles and media
players, allowing users to access IPTV services across different platforms seamlessly.

Can this solution be installed in the cloud?

Yes, IPTV middleware can be installed in the cloud, allowing for scalable and flexible deployment
options. Cloud-based solutions enable service providers to manage content delivery and user
interactions efficiently, without the need for extensive on-premises infrastructure.

# Big events come with big opportunities

Scale premium offerings with differentiated connectivity
[Discover how the game is changing][211]

## Highlights

[[""]][212]
Jul 14, 2026 | Press release

#### [Ericsson releases its Q2 2026 financial report][213]

Ericsson’s Q2 results underscore the strength of its portfolio and disciplined execution, with a
48.4% adjusted gross margin and a strong net cash position. Read the full report.

[[""]][214]
Jun 30, 2026 | Topic

#### [Your guide to differentiated connectivity][215]

Explore the Differentiated Connectivity Handbook – a practical guide to design, launch, and scale
profitable 5G services.

[[""]][216]
May 18, 2026

#### [Ericsson ranked #2 among Europe's top innovators][217]

Fortune's 2026 Most Innovative Companies list places Ericsson second among Europe's leading
companies driving the future of technology.

[[Ericsson Mobility Report June 2026 front cover. ]][218]

#### [Unpack the Mobility Report][219]

Webinar: hear what the latest data signals for service providers and enterprises - straight from the
team behind it.

[[""]][220]
Jun 11, 2026 | Magazine

#### [Four ways to grow your network without growing energy costs][221]

New analysis from Ericsson Research sets out four imperatives for improving energy efficiency at
scale – even with a 3.5x growth in traffic. Get the insights now.

[[""]][222]
May 11, 2026 | Blog post

#### [AI agents solving real network problems][223]

Multi-vendor agentic AI is transforming Cloud RAN troubleshooting. See how it cuts through complex
handoffs to find root causes across the full stack.

The next wave of mobile will transform businesses, unlock network value, and drive innovation.

[Explore our vision][224]

## Your industry

[Discover all industries][225]
[Engineer working on a laptop.]
Communication service providers
Leading connectivity

Enabling advanced 5G capabilities, network slicing, orchestration, and AI-driven tools for superior
connectivity and tailored solutions to unlock new revenue streams.

[Explore Communication service providers][226]
[Industry robots at a manufacturing plant.]
Enterprises
Accelerating innovation

Unlocking growth with communications and connectivity solutions that combine 5G, AI, and cloud for
enhanced productivity, scalability, and resilience.

[Explore enterprise solutions][227]
[Firefighter walking to a firetruck]
Public sector
Advancing society

We empower the public sector through high-performing, secure, reliable and resilient connectivity
that drive digital transformation for government and mission-critical industries. Together, let's
create a future where intelligent networks empower a safer world.

[Explore public sector solutions][228]

# Exceptional Connectivity

## Trusted for over 40 years

Our high-performance network combines the benefits of both GEO and LEO to offer guaranteed video and
internet connectivity reliably on land, at sea and in the air.

[Photo of a press team of a journalist and cameraman on field]

neighbourhoods.

# Exceptional Connectivity

## Trusted for over 40 years

Our high-performance network combines the benefits of both GEO and LEO to offer guaranteed video and
internet connectivity reliably on land, at sea and in the air.

[Aerial photo of a front of a container ship]
[Portrait photo of a man in blue winter clothing]
[Aerial photograph of a desert schene with elephants]

## Tailored Solutions for Every Industry

[ Broadcast & Video ][127]
[Photo of a press team of a journalist and cameraman on field]

Innovative solutions for full-time or occasional broadcast and video delivery by satellite. Reaching
all audiences, no matter how remote, with consistently high-quality content, from our key TV
neighbourhoods. 

[Explore broadcast services][128]
[ Aviation ][129]

inflight connectivity. 

[Explore aviation connectivity][130]
[ Enterprise ][131]
[Photo of a worker wathing a digital screen in his helmet]

and connecting communities in remote, underserved and challenging environments.

[Explore enterprise connectivity][132]
[ Government ][133]
[Image of government soldiers using their laptop]

Secure, assured, resilient and agile multi-orbit satellite connectivity for governments and
international agencies.

[Explore government services][134]
[ Maritime ][135]
[Image of a maritime worker on a boat]

Reliable multi-orbit solutions for high-speed satellite connectivity at sea for business
applications, safety, welfare and entertainment.   

[Explore maritime connectivity][136]
[ Telecoms ][137]
[Image of a woman working on her laptop in a server room]

Multi-orbit satellite services to deliver cellular backhaul connectivity in rural, remote and
underserved communities as a network solution or in an emergency. 

[Explore telecoms solutions][138]

## UNMATCHED PERFORMANCE WITH MULTI-ORBIT SATELLITE NETWORKS

Eutelsat’s GEO fleet and OneWeb LEO constellation deliver resilience and global coverage

With our high-throughput GEO satellites at key orbital positions and low-latency LEO constellation
deployed pole-to-pole, we provide high-performance video and connectivity services for customers
worldwide.

[Explore satellite network ][139]

## European space pioneer

**Combining innovation and experience to deliver customer success **

Eutelsat is a global leader in satellite communications, delivering high-performance connectivity
and broadcasting via our unique multi-orbit GEO-LEO network. With over 40 years of experience and
operations around the world, we provide secure, resilient solutions for broadcasters, governments,
and businesses worldwide. Discover how we’re shaping the future of space-based communications: on
land, at sea, and in the air.

## Email Finder FAQ

If you can't find the answer to your question here, visit the dedicated section in our Help Center.

[Visit Help Center][32]

### How should I use the Email Finder?

You may use this search email address tool to find company email addresses, get prospects' valid
emails and other data about them, both on the platform's web app via Search and Enrich and on
LinkedIn via our Email Finder extension (data can also be searched on prospective companies'
websites).

### What data should I upload to find an email address?

To find an email for a prospect, the following data in our web app set is required: first name, last
name, and the company name of the domain (which can be selected from 17 filters). Based on this
information, GetProspect will provide the email address and other prospect data.

### Is it ethical to use an Email Finder?

If you scrape the email addresses for legitimate purposes, such as sales or job hunting, and they
are collected and used in accordance with applicable laws and regulations, it may be considered
ethical. But, if you extract emails for sending spam, phishing, or any other illegal purpose, then
it’s unethical.

### Where does GetProspect find emails?

GetProspect Email finder uses its powerful database of over 200 million business contacts with
emails and 26 million companies to find email addresses, as well as LinkedIn's largest and most
current business contacts database with over 900 million users.

### How accurate is the Email Finder?

The accuracy of valid emails that were found on the platform is 95%.

According to the latest tests, GetProspect Email Finder found 84 valid email addresses out of 100
contacts, which is higher than in such alternatives as ZoomInfo, Hunter.io, Lusha, ContactOut, and
others.

### How can I extract an email address from a website?

The GetProspect company Email Finder extracts business email addresses from any company website.
Once the extension is installed, it can be used for fetching basic info about the companies,
employees' email addresses and getting essential data about them. Just click on the extension icon
to find emails and leads you need by name or job title.

### Is the Getprospect Email Finder a free service?

GetProspect Email Finder provides lifetime access to 50 free new email addresses each month.

### How much does the Email Finder cost?

Paid Email Finder subscriptions start at $49 per month with 1,000 valid emails and 2,000
verifications. You can find email addresses for just $34 per month with an annual payment. Find out
more about it at [Pricing.][33]

## Email Finder FAQ

If you can't find the answer to your question here, visit the dedicated section in our Help Center.

[Visit Help Center][32]

### How should I use the Email Finder?

You may use this search email address tool to find company email addresses, get prospects' valid
emails and other data about them, both on the platform's web app via Search and Enrich and on
LinkedIn via our Email Finder extension (data can also be searched on prospective companies'
websites).

### What data should I upload to find an email address?

To find an email for a prospect, the following data in our web app set is required: first name, last
name, and the company name of the domain (which can be selected from 17 filters). Based on this
information, GetProspect will provide the email address and other prospect data.

### Is it ethical to use an Email Finder?

If you scrape the email addresses for legitimate purposes, such as sales or job hunting, and they
are collected and used in accordance with applicable laws and regulations, it may be considered
ethical. But, if you extract emails for sending spam, phishing, or any other illegal purpose, then
it’s unethical.

### Where does GetProspect find emails?

GetProspect Email finder uses its powerful database of over 200 million business contacts with
emails and 26 million companies to find email addresses, as well as LinkedIn's largest and most
current business contacts database with over 900 million users.

### How accurate is the Email Finder?

The accuracy of valid emails that were found on the platform is 95%.

According to the latest tests, GetProspect Email Finder found 84 valid email addresses out of 100
contacts, which is higher than in such alternatives as ZoomInfo, Hunter.io, Lusha, ContactOut, and
others.

### How can I extract an email address from a website?

The GetProspect company Email Finder extracts business email addresses from any company website.
Once the extension is installed, it can be used for fetching basic info about the companies,
employees' email addresses and getting essential data about them. Just click on the extension icon
to find emails and leads you need by name or job title.

### Is the Getprospect Email Finder a free service?

GetProspect Email Finder provides lifetime access to 50 free new email addresses each month.

### How much does the Email Finder cost?

Paid Email Finder subscriptions start at $49 per month with 1,000 valid emails and 2,000
verifications. You can find email addresses for just $34 per month with an annual payment. Find out
more about it at [Pricing.][33]

BMS with open architecture and Lonworks / Bacnet compatible DDCs Pharma Suite : 21 CFR Part 11

[Read more ][19]

### [Qualification & Validations][20]

In accordance with the recommendations from International Standards, GMP establishes a Commissioning
and Qualification plan based on Risk analysis that permits the classification of the various systems
and its components depending on their impact on final product quality. We supervise projects all
around the world. Together with our partners, we guarantee top-quality installation and supervisory
operations. Specially trained professionals are provided to perform demanding commissioning tasks
and particle and classification measurements within the field of clean room technology.
[Read more ][21]

### [Office Partitions][22]

GMP specializes in the supply and installation of office partitions. GMP office partitions are fully
relocatable and demountable monoblack systems. With numerous design options available, flexible
solutions can be offered to meet all client requirements.
[Read more ][23]

### [Utilities & Piping][24]

Piping is critical in terms of design and is of utmost importance for any successful Pharmaceutical
or Biotech facility. As it employs very high initial set-up cost and routine maintenance, its design
has to be ideal and cost effective. These utilities are Compressed Air, Steam, Cooling water,
Chilled water, Different types of Gas piping etc. At GMP we make sure that all these utilities are
designed to perform well at its peak use. We ensure cost-effective solutions by avoiding over design
or under design. Less impact on environment and making optimum use of capacity are focused upon,
while we design the insulation materials. The piping standards like ASTM, ASME, BS standards are
followed to assure high quality and a rigid system. Our in-depth knowledge of piping and utility
equipments enables us to build rigid systems with effortless installation along with piping and
integration with different equipment’s, like chillers, cooling towers, Air Compressors and Boilers
etc.
[Read more ][25]

### [Turnkey Services Brief][26]

GMP offers it client a Single window solutions to setup a world standard facility. It undertakes
works with its own manufactured products of Clean room Partitioning system and undertakes Design
built works for all Services for clean room industry.
[Read more ][27]

Cleanroom technology is an essential part for safety and quality maintenance throughout the
production, processing and packaging of a product. The acceptable standards and regulations for this
are stated as per GMP/FDA, ISO 14644, EU GMP, WHO etc and compliance with these is necessary to
maintain reliability. At GMP, we manufacture and provide services for maintaining the perfect
climatic conditions of products and personnel by providing end-to-end solutions right from
laminar-flow benches and extending to turnkey cleanroom systems.

## With Proton, your data belongs to you, not tech companies, governments, or hackers.

[Get your encrypted email][174]

### Fundamentally different

Proton was started in 2014 by scientists who met at CERN and shared a vision of an internet that
defends freedom and puts people first.

Our transparency, open-source software, and rigorous encryption have earned Proton millions of users
— and the recommendation of the United Nations.

Tech companies like Google or Apple define privacy as “nobody can exploit your data, except for us.”
We believe nobody should exploit your data, period.

Our technology and business are based upon this fundamentally stronger definition of privacy, backed
also by Swiss privacy laws.

### Privacy for a better world

At Proton, we believe that a better world begins with privacy, and this is at the heart of
everything we do. Privacy isn’t just something we talk about; it’s a core belief and the reason
Proton was created in the first place.

We also believe in people before profits, and our primary shareholder is the nonprofit [Proton
Foundation][175], whose mission is to fight for an open internet that promotes freedom of speech and
freedom of information.

[Learn about our impact][176]
[Proton Mail]

## Over 100 million people and businesses have signed up for Proton

[Join Proton][177][Proton for Business][178]

### End-to-end encryption

Our end-to-end encryption and zero-access encryption mean that no one (not even Proton) has the
technical means to access your data without your permission.

We don’t sell ads and can’t share your data. At Proton, privacy isn’t a promise, it’s mathematically
ensured.

[Discover Proton’s encryption
][179]

### Swiss privacy

Proton is based in Switzerland, and your data does not go to the cloud. Instead, it stays under the
protection of some of the world’s strongest privacy laws.

We are a neutral and safe haven for your personal data, committed to defending your freedom.

[About Swiss privacy
][180]

### Switching made easy

Proton’s services are so simple and intuitive that anyone can use them. Move your emails, contacts,
and calendars from Google, Outlook, and other providers to Proton in just a few clicks.

Connect your Gmail to Proton Mail to read, send and receive your emails in one place, bringing you
one step closer to leaving behind Big Tech for good.

[Connect your Gmail account
][181]

### Open source and audited

Since we were founded by scientists, we know that trust is earned through transparency and peer
review.

All our apps are open source and independently audited by security experts so that anyone can
inspect them, use them, and trust them.

[Proton and open source
][182]

### One account, any device

Access your email, files, calendars, passwords, and VPN anywhere.

Get Proton apps on all your devices (Android, iPhone and iPad, Windows, macOS, Linux, and more) with
one Proton Account for all our privacy-by-default services.

[See all Proton services
][183]

### Free forever

Privacy is a human right, so our services are always available for free, and our encryption tech is
free as well.

Proton has no ads and does not sell your data. You can support the service by upgrading to a paid
account with more features.

[Get a free Proton account
][184]

and tailored solutions empower businesses with reliability and global reach.

### [One Platform, 70+ Enterprise-Grade Features][136]

Revoical provides an all-in-one cloud PBX packed with over 70 essential communication features
including call forwarding, hunt groups, voicemail-to-email, SMS/MMS, fax, numbering, and APIs.
Unlike other providers, you don’t pay extra to unlock features; every plan includes the full suite
so your team always has the tools it needs to stay connected.

# ABOUT SABIC

From making cars and planes more fuel-efficient, to helping conserve the world’s water supply and
enabling colorful smartphone cases, we find solutions to the challenges of today to help our
customers achieve their ambitions and build a better tomorrow.

## Products

We gain insights by understanding our customers’ needs and use our technical expertise to tailor
solutions to help maximize their market advantage moving forward.

Sustainability is a vital part of our core business strategy. We're making sure we understand the
megatrends that will impact on our lives in the years to come.

## Investors

We’re committed to long-term investments and business partnerships, by harnessing innovation,
learning and operational excellence.

## CAREERS

People have helped us to develop, produce and market innovative solutions that make a difference
both to industry and to humanity. At SABIC we enable you to realize your ideas and make an impact.

## Our Brand

We believe the answer to some of the world's biggest challenges lies in the natural human instinct
to collaborate. Together we're making Chemistry that Matters™.

## Our Stories

For over 45 years, our ambition to define the future of petrochemicals has yielded solutions for the
challenges of today and helped our customers achieve their ambitions for a better tomorrow. We are
making a meaningful impact in the world and delivering Chemistry that Matters™.

# ABOUT SABIC

From making cars and planes more fuel-efficient, to helping conserve the world’s water supply and
enabling colorful smartphone cases, we find solutions to the challenges of today to help our
customers achieve their ambitions and build a better tomorrow.

## Our Industries
* [ [agriculture]Agriculture ][168]

* [ [Healthcare]Hygiene & Healthcare ][173]
* [ [Industrial]Industrial ][174]
* [ [Mass]Mass Transportation ][175]
* [ [Packaging]Packaging ][176]

[OUR INDUSTRIES][177]

[A man holding looking at a tablet screen with a chart]

## Products

We gain insights by understanding our customers’ needs and use our technical expertise to tailor
solutions to help maximize their market advantage moving forward.

[OUR PRODUCTS][178]

## Sustainability

Sustainability is a vital part of our core business strategy. We're making sure we understand the
megatrends that will impact on our lives in the years to come.

[LATEST SUSTAINABILITY REPORTING][179]
[Two]

## Investors

We’re committed to long-term investments and business partnerships, by harnessing innovation,
learning and operational excellence.

[INVESTORS][180]

## CAREERS

People have helped us to develop, produce and market innovative solutions that make a difference
both to industry and to humanity. At SABIC we enable you to realize your ideas and make an impact.

[VIEW JOB OPPORTUNITIES][181]
[Three people looking at a whiteboard]
[
][182]

## Our Brand

We believe the answer to some of the world's biggest challenges lies in the natural human instinct
to collaborate. Together we're making Chemistry that Matters™.

[Our Brand][183]

## Our Stories

For over 45 years, our ambition to define the future of petrochemicals has yielded solutions for the
challenges of today and helped our customers achieve their ambitions for a better tomorrow. We are
making a meaningful impact in the world and delivering Chemistry that Matters™.

[Read our stories][184]

## Frequently Asked Questions

Below, you will find answers to the questions we get most asked about using Soundiiz.

How does Soundiiz transfer playlists?
Soundiiz reads the playlist on your source service and uses track metadata such as the title,
artist, and album to find corresponding tracks in the destination catalog. Tracks that are
unavailable or cannot be matched are listed in the transfer report.
Is Soundiiz safe?
Soundiiz connects through the authorization methods offered by each music service, and access can be
revoked from the service account settings. Soundiiz is operated in France and follows GDPR
requirements. [Learn more about security and privacy][75].
Can I use Soundiiz for a one-time transfer?
Yes. You can use the free plan for eligible one-by-one playlist transfers, or subscribe to a monthly
plan for batch and advanced transfer features. If you cancel the subscription, paid features remain
available until the end of the billing period.
How do I cancel my Soundiiz subscription?
You can cancel your subscription at any time in your user settings. Need a step-by-step tutorial?
See [how to cancel your Soundiiz subscription][76].
Does Soundiiz remove my playlists and favorites from the source platform?
No. A transfer copies matched playlists and supported favorites to the destination service. It does
not delete or modify the source collection.

## What music lovers say about Soundiiz

Read how music listeners, collectors, and playlist curators use Soundiiz across streaming services.

I’ve used one service for years as part of a family plan and recently prefer to use another because
I like its app interface and features better...
Jean
I really like Soundiiz service and the convenience in using it has improved greatly over time. A few
further developments, which I'm sure will come, and it will be 5 stars.
Ralf
Best playlist manager across streaming services ! Regular addition of features and services. Easy
web interface...

Soundiiz is a great service that does what it says it will do, at a reasonable cost. It's mainly
oriented to playlists, but they are continuing to add features...

I decided to ditch Tidal in favour of Qobuz because I was tired of tracks just stopping playing at
random. I used Soundiiz to transfer my playlists and the experience was wonderful...
Lindsay
I used it to monitor playlist changes on Spotify and make the update on my Qobuz playlist so that I
can play them in CD quality...
Tebby

## Frequently Asked Questions

Below, you will find answers to the questions we get most asked about using Soundiiz.

How does Soundiiz transfer playlists?
Soundiiz reads the playlist on your source service and uses track metadata such as the title,
artist, and album to find corresponding tracks in the destination catalog. Tracks that are
unavailable or cannot be matched are listed in the transfer report.
Is Soundiiz safe?
Soundiiz connects through the authorization methods offered by each music service, and access can be
revoked from the service account settings. Soundiiz is operated in France and follows GDPR
requirements. [Learn more about security and privacy][75].
Can I use Soundiiz for a one-time transfer?
Yes. You can use the free plan for eligible one-by-one playlist transfers, or subscribe to a monthly
plan for batch and advanced transfer features. If you cancel the subscription, paid features remain
available until the end of the billing period.
How do I cancel my Soundiiz subscription?
You can cancel your subscription at any time in your user settings. Need a step-by-step tutorial?
See [how to cancel your Soundiiz subscription][76].
Does Soundiiz remove my playlists and favorites from the source platform?
No. A transfer copies matched playlists and supported favorites to the destination service. It does
not delete or modify the source collection.

International development and manufacturing company

multichannel logging, broadcast automation, graphics playout, and interactive television support.

software, production automation systems, HD/SD-SDI and Composite to IP TS encoders.

* #### Sports Awards
  
  # Leaders Sports Awards
  
  The COVID-19 pandemic brought the sport world to a stop with most events either postponed or
  cancelled. In an attempt to answer this crisis, right holders have turned to different forms of
  virtual alternatives to keep providing content to their audiences. We therefore asked ourselves:
  how could we contribute to bring real sports back on TV and other digital platforms? Distributed
  timekeeping was our answer! Our efforts have been recognized by winning the prestigious LEADERS
  SPORTS AWARDS 2020 in the Innovation category, with competitors being nothing less than F1 and
  Sky, among others!
  
  [ Read more ][134]
* #### Result Service
  
  # The sports timekeeping specialist behind the great brands
  
  Swiss Timing, a Swatch Group company, is one of the world’s leading sports timekeepers. Its global
  reputation is based on an unparalleled range of services and a legacy of innovation. Swiss Timing
  not only provides timekeeping, data handling, and results distribution, it is also behind the
  development of the industry’s most important technology. For more than 40 years, Swiss Timing has
  been one of the most trusted and innovative names in sport.
  
  [ Read more ][135]
* #### timing
  
  # The service that gave us our name
  
  There’s no question that timekeeping is one of the key components contributing to the excitement
  of a sporting competition. Without the ability to measure the times and distances that separate a
  winner from the runners-up, competition as we know it would be impossible. Without timing, there
  would be no world or Olympic records.
  
  [ Read more ][136]

* #### Sports Awards
  
  # Leaders Sports Awards
  
  The COVID-19 pandemic brought the sport world to a stop with most events either postponed or
  cancelled. In an attempt to answer this crisis, right holders have turned to different forms of
  virtual alternatives to keep providing content to their audiences. We therefore asked ourselves:
  how could we contribute to bring real sports back on TV and other digital platforms? Distributed
  timekeeping was our answer! Our efforts have been recognized by winning the prestigious LEADERS
  SPORTS AWARDS 2020 in the Innovation category, with competitors being nothing less than F1 and
  Sky, among others!
  
  [ Read more ][134]
* #### Result Service
  
  # The sports timekeeping specialist behind the great brands
  
  Swiss Timing, a Swatch Group company, is one of the world’s leading sports timekeepers. Its global
  reputation is based on an unparalleled range of services and a legacy of innovation. Swiss Timing
  not only provides timekeeping, data handling, and results distribution, it is also behind the
  development of the industry’s most important technology. For more than 40 years, Swiss Timing has
  been one of the most trusted and innovative names in sport.
  
  [ Read more ][135]
* #### timing
  
  # The service that gave us our name
  
  There’s no question that timekeeping is one of the key components contributing to the excitement
  of a sporting competition. Without the ability to measure the times and distances that separate a
  winner from the runners-up, competition as we know it would be impossible. Without timing, there
  would be no world or Olympic records.
  
  [ Read more ][136]
* #### Services
  
  # Instant information for every Audience
  
  The drive to achieve a fabulous result in a competitive event motivates athletes in every sport.
  And while fans attending the games or watching them on television enjoy the beauty and nobility of
  a great performance, every eye at the venue (or at home) turns immediately to the scoreboards to
  see the final results. Was it a world record? Who were the top three finishers? Did my hero
  qualify for the finals?
  
  [ Read more ][137]

## FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS (FAQ's)

Find answers to common questions about TeleOSS SMS Gateway Software

What is TeleOSS?

TeleOSS is an advanced A2P SMS gateway and messaging platform that enables telecom operators,
aggregators, and enterprises to manage and scale their messaging operations efficiently. It supports
SMS, WhatsApp, Viber, RCS, and other channels.

Who uses TeleOSS?

TeleOSS is used by telecom operators, SMS aggregators, SMS hubbing providers, MNOs, enterprises, and
CPaaS providers to handle high-volume A2P messaging, routing, billing, and compliance.

What makes TeleOSS different from other SMS gateway platforms?

TeleOSS offers end-to-end automation, robust routing and billing engines, advanced analytics, and
support for multi-channel messaging. It is scalable, secure, and highly customizable.

Does TeleOSS support international SMS delivery?

Yes, TeleOSS supports global SMS routing and delivery through integration with multiple carriers and
SMS hubs. It includes real-time monitoring and intelligent fallback for better delivery rates.
SMS Wholsale soltion.

Is TeleOSS suitable for telecom operators and SMS Hubbing?

Absolutely. TeleOSS offers a dedicated SMS Hub and SMSC solution tailored for operators and hubbing
providers, with features like least-cost routing (LCR), SS7 integration, DLR tracking, and MNP
lookups.

Can TeleOSS be used as a CPaaS platform?

Yes, TeleOSS can be deployed as a full CPaaS solution offering APIs for developers, multi-channel
messaging (SMS, WhatsApp, RCS), and integrations with enterprise systems.

Is TeleOSS a cloud-based or on-premise solution?

TeleOSS can be deployed both on-cloud and on-premise based on customer needs. It also supports
hybrid deployments for flexibility and data security.

What is TeleOSS?

TeleOSS is an advanced A2P SMS gateway and messaging platform that enables telecom operators,
aggregators, and enterprises to manage and scale their messaging operations efficiently. It supports
SMS, WhatsApp, Viber, RCS, and other channels.

Who uses TeleOSS?

TeleOSS is used by telecom operators, SMS aggregators, SMS hubbing providers, MNOs, enterprises, and
CPaaS providers to handle high-volume A2P messaging, routing, billing, and compliance.

What makes TeleOSS different from other SMS gateway platforms?

TeleOSS offers end-to-end automation, robust routing and billing engines, advanced analytics, and
support for multi-channel messaging. It is scalable, secure, and highly customizable.

Does TeleOSS support international SMS delivery?

Yes, TeleOSS supports global SMS routing and delivery through integration with multiple carriers and
SMS hubs. It includes real-time monitoring and intelligent fallback for better delivery rates.

Is TeleOSS suitable for telecom operators and SMS Hubbing?

Absolutely. TeleOSS offers a dedicated SMS Hub and SMSC solution tailored for operators and hubbing
providers, with features like least-cost routing (LCR), SS7 integration, DLR tracking, and MNP
lookups.

Can TeleOSS be used as a CPaaS platform?

Yes, TeleOSS can be deployed as a full CPaaS solution offering APIs for developers, multi-channel
messaging (SMS, WhatsApp, RCS), and integrations with enterprise systems.

Is TeleOSS a cloud-based or on-premise solution?

TeleOSS can be deployed both on-cloud and on-premise based on customer needs. It also supports
hybrid deployments for flexibility and data security.

Introducing the first ever 24/7 live stream designer. Enjoy a Figma-like experience while designing
your live streams - add current song overlays, visualizers, and customize your stream to match your
brand with our intuitive interface. Try it out now and make your content stand out!

Stream live to YouTube, Twitch, Facebook, TikTok, Kick, Rumble, and any RTMP destination - all at

up to 10 platforms simultaneously.

## Build & design custom 24/7 live streams for your brand

Get ready to take your music to the next level with Upstream. Build stunning 24/7 live streams with
your favorite playlists, design custom visuals, and engage with your fans in real-time. Share your
passion for music and create a unique experience.

From thrilling gameplay sessions to engaging commentary, Upstream empowers you to take your gaming
content to the next level. Connect with fellow gamers, share your expertise, and create a
captivating experience that keeps viewers coming back.

Strengthen your religious community with the power of live streaming. Create immersive 24/7 live
streams of religious services, ceremonies or meditations. Engage your congregation and reach a wider
audience, sharing hope and positivity.

Unlock new opportunities for your business with 24/7 live streams. Host webinars and product
demonstrations that cater specifically to businesses and professionals. Expand your reach, build
industry connections, and showcase your expertise.

Stay ahead of the news game with Upstream. Launch your own news channel and deliver real-time
updates, interviews, and breaking news to your viewers. Connect with your audience, foster
engagement, and become a reliable source of information.

The possibilities are endless with Upstream. Whether you're a fitness instructor, a chef, or a

Share your expertise and build a community around your brand.

FAQ

## General questions

Quick answers about streaming with Upstream. Browse the full FAQ for setup guides and
platform-specific help.

01 What is Upstream?

Upstream is cloud-based live streaming software for multistreaming to up to 10 platforms at once,
running 24/7 always-on channels, scheduling live streams from pre-recorded video, and going live
from a browser-based studio, with no OBS or powerful computer required.

02 Which platforms can I stream to?

Stream to YouTube, Twitch, Kick, Facebook, TikTok, Instagram, LinkedIn, Rumble, and any custom RTMP
destination, up to 10 destinations from a single feed.

03 Is there a free plan?

Yes. The free plan includes 24 hours of streaming every month, one stream, and full functionality,
with no credit card required.

04 Do I need OBS or a powerful computer?

No. Upstream runs in the cloud, so you can stream from your browser or send one feed and let
Upstream handle the fan-out, keeping your CPU and upload load low.

# Effiziente und systemische Klima- und Energielösungen

Über uns

## Viessmann steht für Erfahrung, Qualität und Innovation

Innovationskraft ist der Schlüssel zur Zukunft. Deshalb arbeiten wir seit über 100 Jahren Tag für
Tag daran, die Grenzen des technisch Möglichen neu zu definieren – für unsere Kunden, unsere Partner
und zukünftige Generationen.

[ Mehr über unsere Marke erfahren ][58]

Lösungen mit System

## Wir setzen auf ein intelligentes Portfolio

Heizen, Kühlen, Lüften und Strom erzeugen – mit unseren Energie- und Klimalösungen für Neubau und
Modernisierung verfolgen wir einen ganzheitlichen Ansatz. Intelligente Systemkomponenten sowie
digitale Services gewährleisten hohe Effizienz und Komfort.
* #### Wärme und Strom
  
  Unsere Energie- und Heizlösungen für Wohngebäude gewährleisten ein perfektes Zusammenspiel von
  Wärme und Strom. Das gilt für klassische sowie regenerative Technologien.
  
  [ Mehr erfahren ][59]
  [Das Bild zeigt Viessmann Produkte, einen Mann und eine Frau.]
* #### Klimaanlagen
  
  Optimales Raumklima und hohe Luftqualität – seit 2023 rundet der Bereich Klimaanlagen das
  Viessmann Climate Solutions Produktportfolio ab. Modernste Technologie vereint Effizienz und
  Komfort.
  
  [ Mehr erfahren ][60]
  [Das Bild zeigt Viessmann Vitoclima 300S Klimagerät an der Wand montiert]
* #### Lüftung
  
  Einzelne Räume oder gesamte Gebäude – unsere Lüftungssysteme gewährleisten einen geregelten
  Luftaustausch. Das wirkt sich positiv auf Luftqualität und Gebäudesubstanz aus.
  
  [ Mehr erfahren ][61]
  [Das Bild zeigt das Ventilation system und ein Mädchen]
* #### Gewerbe und Industrie
  
  Planung, Installation und Wartung – für unsere Kunden entwickeln wir maßgeschneiderte Lösungen für
  eine wirtschaftliche Versorgung mit Wärme, Dampf und Strom.
  
  [ Mehr erfahren ][62]
  [Das Bild zeigt eine Industrieanlage im Hintergrund und ein Tablet mit Daten im Vordergrund.]
* #### Digitale Services
  
  Steuerung, Inbetriebnahme und Wartung – unsere digitalen Services ebnen den Weg zu noch mehr
  Effizienz und erleichtern sowohl unseren Kunden als auch unseren Partnern den Alltag.
  
  [ Mehr erfahren ][63]
  [Das Bild zeigt digitale Dienste auf einem Smartphone für die Energiekontrolle in Häusern.]

Nachhaltigkeitsfragen.

# Effiziente und systemische Klima- und Energielösungen

Über uns

## Viessmann steht für Erfahrung, Qualität und Innovation

Innovationskraft ist der Schlüssel zur Zukunft. Deshalb arbeiten wir seit über 100 Jahren Tag für
Tag daran, die Grenzen des technisch Möglichen neu zu definieren – für unsere Kunden, unsere Partner
und zukünftige Generationen.

[ Mehr über unsere Marke erfahren ][58]
[Das Bild zeigt zwei Viessmann Mitarbeiter in der Produktion mit einer Wärmepumpe]
[Das Bild zeigt einen Mitarbeiter bei der Montage in der Produktionsstätte Allendorf.]
[Das Bild zeigt eine Familie und eine Wärmepumpe.]
[Das Bild zeigt das Hauptgebäude in Allendorf (Eder).]
Lösungen mit System

## Wir setzen auf ein intelligentes Portfolio

Heizen, Kühlen, Lüften und Strom erzeugen – mit unseren Energie- und Klimalösungen für Neubau und
Modernisierung verfolgen wir einen ganzheitlichen Ansatz. Intelligente Systemkomponenten sowie
digitale Services gewährleisten hohe Effizienz und Komfort.
* #### Wärme und Strom
  
  Unsere Energie- und Heizlösungen für Wohngebäude gewährleisten ein perfektes Zusammenspiel von
  Wärme und Strom. Das gilt für klassische sowie regenerative Technologien.
  
  [ Mehr erfahren ][59]
  [Das Bild zeigt Viessmann Produkte, einen Mann und eine Frau.]
* #### Klimaanlagen
  
  Optimales Raumklima und hohe Luftqualität – seit 2023 rundet der Bereich Klimaanlagen das
  Viessmann Climate Solutions Produktportfolio ab. Modernste Technologie vereint Effizienz und
  Komfort.
  
  [ Mehr erfahren ][60]
  [Das Bild zeigt Viessmann Vitoclima 300S Klimagerät an der Wand montiert]
* #### Lüftung
  
  Einzelne Räume oder gesamte Gebäude – unsere Lüftungssysteme gewährleisten einen geregelten
  Luftaustausch. Das wirkt sich positiv auf Luftqualität und Gebäudesubstanz aus.
  
  [ Mehr erfahren ][61]
  [Das Bild zeigt das Ventilation system und ein Mädchen]
* #### Gewerbe und Industrie
  
  Planung, Installation und Wartung – für unsere Kunden entwickeln wir maßgeschneiderte Lösungen für
  eine wirtschaftliche Versorgung mit Wärme, Dampf und Strom.
  
  [ Mehr erfahren ][62]
  [Das Bild zeigt eine Industrieanlage im Hintergrund und ein Tablet mit Daten im Vordergrund.]
* #### Digitale Services
  
  Steuerung, Inbetriebnahme und Wartung – unsere digitalen Services ebnen den Weg zu noch mehr
  Effizienz und erleichtern sowohl unseren Kunden als auch unseren Partnern den Alltag.
  
  [ Mehr erfahren ][63]
  [Das Bild zeigt digitale Dienste auf einem Smartphone für die Energiekontrolle in Häusern.]

[Bild zeigt lachende Mitarbeiterin im Viessmann Werk Allendorf.]
[Das Bild zeigt ein Baumblatt mit Wassertropfen]

Nachhaltigkeitsfragen.
